IP Source Group Resource Get Source IP Groups Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipSourceGroups/lite

Gets a name and ID dictionary of all IP source groups.

Note: This endpoint retrieves only IPv4 source address groups. Organizations that have enabled IPv6 can use GET /ipSourceGroups/ipv6SourceGroups/lite to retrieve IPv6 source address groups.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

A unique identifier of the source IP address group.

name
string

The name of the source IP address group.

ipAddresses
string[]

Source IP addresses added to the group.

description
string

The description of the source IP address group.

isNonEditable
boolean

If set to true, the source IP address group is non-editable. This field is applicable only to predefined IP address groups, which cannot be modified.

]
